en: Who knows whose misfortune it was
Ebedey and Kozoy prevailed
The two sat in the saddle
He suffered at my side
Their faith was corrupted
That one soul from the faithful
Then not one soul was spared
Driving the white livestock through the mountains
Raising a loud battle cry
Again a warrior for this torment
He did not dismount from his horse
None truly ordered the liquor
There were no truths spoken by heroes
No man destroyed the beast
Making strife on a roadless way
There was no fool worse than this
Four descended and struck a thousand
Turning Kozoy’s face
Did Charak stand dividing them
These two men who never aged
Were they God-struck beasts
So spoke Ak Joltoy
Shaking his head at the dream’s meaning
He listened and turned
Unable to find the entrusted one
He came among the people
Giving counsel and reflecting
Your dear uncle Joltoy
Carried his weapons
There is worth in turning from the straight path
There is guilt upon the brow
There is a flowing black whip
What anger had spoken
O child, there is one who said drive him here
The eye cannot measure the wrestler
One who rejoiced and played
Drawing horses from many racers
If he comes, strike without holding back
He changed his good name
He arrayed the exhausted army
The age would be true if he lived
Your words truly remained for spring
Each of his words to every person
To a person with wisdom
If you hear it, reflect
Concerning your uncle Ak Joltoy
Ebedey and Kozoy were gone
The red-eyed one left for battle
He had a soul that struck with the sword
At his head was a dark companion
If a war host came directly
The heavens thundered and wailed
We will prepare much powder and shot
Whose eye a crow had pecked,
Who washed his back in cool water.
Taking a bullet from the hostile people,
Splitting stone with his beak,
Making the base of the walnut tree whistle,
From the wrestler whom no horse could charge,
Who gained renown by wrestling face-to-face,
Who went to the brown autumn pasture,
Whom the swift bird could not catch,
Who rose mightily above the clouds,
Who set birch twigs upon the water,
Whose green juniper covered the sky,
Training him amid the shouting,
The giant hogweed of the heavens,
Saying he had routed the Kazayka mounts,
Dear Zholtoy called out,
From Medeyzu [?],
He had his homeland sought this way,
From which place had he fled,
Light covered his pale eyes,
His collar was of patterned felt,
Found in Talas,
The fearless golden eagle,
Who had never seen a mature mare,
The swift horse, like a mullah in white bagdan,
When he encountered the golden eagle,
Not inferior to a mountain eagle,
Not yielding to a crag eagle,
The little pup brought down livestock.
Ak Zholtoy, riding bareback,
From atop Kulansur,
He sprang down like an arrow,
My knowing Zhadygoy,
When turmoil was put into his mouth,
Against all the others,
Fleeing into the hollow between them,
A crow had pecked out his eye,
Ak Zholtoy, without a sound,
Making the patches into horses,
Taking the blind enemy as his aim,
Voicing his abundant wisdom,
His white neck called Kökürök,
Whenever he began to speak,
Until the many came to know,
If they jabbed with spears,
As though thrusting straight at the face,
There, upon the open steppe,
There were campaigns of every kind,
Every cry of Ak Zholtoy,
Hurling himself like an arrow,
Hey, at Kozloy's [?] voice,
They drew their swords with a flourish,
The heroes brought them on and raced.
Hear your turn,
Calling you a tiger among them,
A strange snow gave birth—I am a Sart,
Erchiy and Kozhoy, the two friends,
So you were the elder sister who passed,
He went far away; let the deed be completed,
Like a shepherd extending a spear,
There is neither distant China nor Kyzyl,
Without turning back through the ages,
One who has not come since the time of the sword,
Think, my sweet heart,
I will place my world in the seat of honor,
Your group was together as one,
Its flaming appearance spreads,
Giving one’s life with growing faith,
Let me stand as a covering,
Even if I gather an army for the fortification,
Would I grow old for the campaign,
However many Kalmyks turn aside,
Taking heads equal to ten,
Kögöy and Kozoy—the two honored ones,
If you save Manas from the enemy,
If you cross and see the sunlit mountains,
If you stir up the camp thoroughly,
You will see your champion,
The sign is the model of the word,
It cannot be found by one who understands speech,
In short, the famed Joytoy,
Another’s enemy from here,
Another has none, his hand cannot reach,
If you face the enemy apart from the others,
See the warrior’s secret as support,
If you are numerous, if you are a song,
If you are a hero when united,
Will it not fall into the hands at the mound,
If you are a diverse people who have prospered,
Will the enemy not disturb the heart,
If you are divided, you are violent,
With the men, we shall not be broken,
And drove them into anxious thought
From that day it was thus
Keeping watch in that manner
If a head were cut off, all the people would know
He was cowed and frightened by this
Those two khans of Karagul
Settled themselves at Belen’s ridge
One guarded the pass
A heart of iron, a steadfast heart
He would not yield easily to an enemy
For the sake of those men
A legacy remained afterward
To the people, Kozoy and the two clans
They seized and took the livestock
They became masters of the divided herds
Spilling blood in the deep mountains
They joined it to Turdungko
This victory was Ak Jолтой’s
Regard it as the fruit of your great strength
Your elder gathered the inheritance
Strike the black host in this place
Those two heroes of Kozoy
All fell into the struggle
The two chargers did not break
From the place where they stood
He firmly cast down the white pavilion
You stand there in great commotion
You are an immovable iron body
Tell me, what road leads to the seat of honor
My rear will not fail or break
Even if a thousand of every thousand come
You have broken those whose saddles never slipped
I will hear the word behind you
I am of the two children
Kozoy and Jолтой from here
Our land knows the prepared place
Our land will not be ruined
Leaving the ford, seeking the land
Searching this way with resolve
Taking Kökötöy at the front
What came from the three valleys
You drove them onto the ridge and struck them
With a shout you split the enemy
The son of the land he encountered
Was he truly equal to the hero
You gave support along the road
You struck all the golden host
You set right all that had gone astray
Laying a hand upon the horse’s mane
You darkened them all like coal
You cut through every forelock
Lamenting in grief
You struck all their horses
Was this alone what you had taken
Do not surrender your rear to the ground
The open steppe gave me its power
You should side with Kozoy
Hearing word from your caravan man
Having been born into this world
Hearing that Kenen had come
Coming to my father Kongur
Moving as an ally
If death comes, without hesitation
As though gathering up one’s life
Sharing one purpose together
Our lives together through the world’s turmoil
He joined their midst
Following the road through harsh words
I am the one who kept the treasury moving
When you saw him, you received him
It was for that very month
Created by the one God
The rest were merely kin
To wise and generous Kenen
Your in-laws became enemies
In the fierce battle of destruction
However far they might pursue
This alone was what remained
Ebegey and Kozoy, the two friends
Set him on the road so he may understand
What remained after entering the people
Ebegey spoke again
I am called Ebegey
The pale stallion that never tires
You travel abreast across the broad land
To your formidable father Kenen
From now on I shall stand watching
If you enter among the enemy
I asked what they had left unsaid
To dear lord Kenen
I am fierce when defending the homeland
If Kenen receives him
You will go out against the enemy at the front
Turning the steel blade
If the day is won, he will not part
You gathered the true words
Ebegey rose the next day
Of black Kongur with the blue mane
Come, Kozoy, rise now
Ebegey and Kozoy together
The whole age stood astonished
When the father came forth
He laid out the place of honor
Finding no enemy at the camp
Shall we leave him with his bedding
A hero’s heart and a warrior’s courage
Let no living soul overtake you
We bound our cause to the world
Setting the bull beneath the standard
A pale enemy lies beyond ruined Kongur
Listen thoughtfully, our collective farm,
